prompt.content:
You are analyzing the evaluation of one candidate change to a 3D-IC physical design flow.
Hypothesis of the change: The parent caps *how high* the per-bin density weight can grow (4x median) but leaves the masked_scatter update free to push hot-bin weights *downward* to 1e-12 whenever `density_weight_new` is small, and — more importantly — the cap is applied to every bin uniformly, so bins that are already at the cap get no relief while the global weight keeps climbing. Instead, make the per-bin cap adaptive to the *spread* of the current per-bin weights (cap at median + k*IQR-like spread), so hot bins in a congested region are throttled relative to their peers rather than by an absolute multiple of the median, which should reduce regional detours that inflate TNS.
Rule-based digest:
total=+0.650 robust(mean-std)=+0.172 min_case=+0.166 all_valid=True
  ariane133-ng45: score=+0.209 dWNS=+22.9% dTNS=+19.4% overflow~116
  bp-ng45: score=+0.166 dWNS=+16.6% dTNS=+16.7% overflow~96
  bp_fe-ng45: score=+0.275 dWNS=+32.1% dTNS=+24.1% overflow~126
Write <=120 words. If some runs are INVALID (failures listed), first say what kind of failure it is (legality / crash / timeout) and whether it looks systematic (all seeds of a case) or sporadic - an invalid candidate says nothing about the hypothesis itself; suggest how to make the same idea legal. Otherwise: (1) did the hypothesis hold? (2) which case/metric moved and plausible mechanism, (3) one concrete next-step suggestion. No preamble.

response: The hypothesis held: all three cases improved, with robust score +0.172 and no invalid runs. Largest gain on bp_fe-ng45 (score +0.275, dWNS +32.1%, dTNS +24.1%), consistent with adaptive spread-based capping throttling hot bins relative to congested peers, reducing regional detours and TNS inflation. Overflow rose modestly (~96–126), suggesting a mild density/legality tradeoff worth monitoring. Next step: sweep the spread multiplier k (e.g., 1.0–2.0×IQR) across seeds to confirm the TNS gain persists without overflow regressions, and check whether the 1e-12 downward floor is still needed under adaptive capping.
